title: Breakfast for the Crews

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: The boat crews camped by the lake last night. This morning they're hungry!

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: Mr. Tobias sent bread rolls. Will you share them so every crew has the same?

steps.speaker: finn
steps.prompt: Share the rolls so every crew has the same.

older.prompt: Share twenty-two rolls among five crews. What about any left over?

feedback.all_good: Five each. Fair winds and full tummies!

outro.speaker: finn
outro.text: Everyone fed, and everyone the same. That's how a regatta should end.

journal_line: I shared breakfast with the boat crews at the lake.
